name: Grafico 5: Taxa de Atraso por Estado do Cliente

native.query:
SELECT estado AS estado, pct_late * 100 AS taxa_atraso_percentual, order_count AS volume_pedidos
FROM ANALYTICS.mart_delivery_kpis
WHERE 1=1
  [[AND estado = {{estado}}]]
  ORDER BY pct_late DESC

name: Grafico 6: Sentimento do Cliente por Categoria de Produto

native.query:
SELECT p.category_name_english AS categoria,
COUNT(r.review_key) AS total_reviews,
(SUM(CASE WHEN r.sentiment_label = 'positivo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_key), 0)::FLOAT) * 100 AS pct_positivo,
(SUM(CASE WHEN r.sentiment_label = 'neutro' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_key), 0)::FLOAT) * 100 AS pct_neutro,
(SUM(CASE WHEN r.sentiment_label = 'negativo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_key), 0)::FLOAT) * 100 AS pct_negativo
FROM ANALYTICS.fact_reviews r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, product_key FROM ANALYTICS.fact_order_items QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_item_id) = 1) pi ON r.order_id = pi.order_id
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.dim_products p ON pi.product_key = p.product_key
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.fact_orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.dim_customers c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE p.category_name_english IS NOT NULL
  [[AND c.estado = {{estado}}]]
  GROUP BY p.category_name_english
  ORDER BY total_reviews DESC
  LIMIT 15

name: Grafico 7: Comparacao de Metricas do ML no Teste

native.query:
WITH metrics_hardcode AS (
    SELECT
        'Regressao Logistica (Numpy Scratch)' AS modelo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = predicted_label_hardcode THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS accuracy,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'late' AND predicted_label_hardcode = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) 
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) AS recall_late,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'late' AND predicted_label_hardcode = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) 
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN predicted_label_hardcode = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) AS precision_late
    FROM ANALYTICS.mart_ml_results
    WHERE 1=1
      [[AND estado = {{estado}}]]
),
metrics_sklearn AS (
    SELECT
        'Regressao Logistica (Scikit-Learn)' AS modelo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = predicted_label_sklearn THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS accuracy,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'late' AND predicted_label_sklearn = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) 
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) AS recall_late,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'late' AND predicted_label_sklearn = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) 
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN predicted_label_sklearn = 'late' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) AS precision_late
    FROM ANALYTICS.mart_ml_results
    WHERE 1=1
      [[AND estado = {{estado}}]]
),
metrics_baseline AS (
    SELECT
        'Baseline (Majority Class)' AS modelo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN true_label = 'on_time' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS accuracy,
        0.0 AS recall_late,
        0.0 AS precision_late
    FROM ANALYTICS.mart_ml_results
    WHERE 1=1
      [[AND estado = {{estado}}]]
),
consolidated AS (
    SELECT * FROM metrics_hardcode
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM metrics_sklearn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM metrics_baseline
)
SELECT
    modelo,
    accuracy * 100 AS acuracia_pct,
    recall_late * 100 AS recall_atraso_pct,
    precision_late * 100 AS precisao_atraso_pct,
    COALESCE((2 * (precision_late * recall_late) / NULLIF(precision_late + recall_late, 0)) * 100, 0) AS f1_atraso_pct
FROM consolidated

name: Tabela 8: Detalhes de Erro de ML (Analise Qualitativa)

native.query:
SELECT 
    order_id AS id_pedido,
    estado AS estado_cliente,
    true_label AS status_real,
    predicted_label_hardcode AS predicao_numpy,
    predicted_label_sklearn AS predicao_sklearn,
    predicted_at AS data_previsao
FROM ANALYTICS.mart_ml_results
WHERE sklearn_correct = FALSE
  [[AND estado = {{estado}}]]
ORDER BY predicted_at DESC
LIMIT 20
